description.value: One of four campgrounds within busy Cultus Lake Park, sitting beside a large warm freshwater lake ringed by forested mountains about 90 minutes from Vancouver; fully serviced with showers and flush toilets, though swimmer's itch and a sudden nearshore drop-off are noted lake hazards.

raw_osm.name: Entrance Bay Campground
raw_osm.operator: Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The fetched website is the BC Parks overview page for Cultus Lake Park, which explicitly references an 'Entrance Bay campground map [PDF]' confirming the campground exists as one of four campgrounds in the park. The page lists reservation policy links for frontcountry camping, confirming reservations are accepted. The nearby Cultus Lake community section mentions restaurants and a laundromat, supporting 'Food nearby'; no campground-specific amenity details (showers, water, etc.) are provided in the fetched text.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to the general Cultus Lake Park overview page, not to a booking or Entrance Bay-specific page; campground-level amenity details (showers, water, hiker/biker sites) could not be confirmed from the fetched content.

The listed phone number (+1-604-986-9371) is the operator (Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.) contact per OSM; the BC Parks website page did not display a matching phone number in the fetched text, so phone confirmation is inconclusive.
No civic address is present in the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, fee-based provincial park campground with confirmed reservations and proximity to services; a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on Lower Mainland routes.
enrichment_extras.notes: A dedicated Entrance Bay campground map PDF is linked from the BC Parks page; future enrichment could extract amenity details from that PDF or the reservations system (e.g., Discover Camping).
